profile.name: Wang bobo
profile.headline: Cybersecurity & Software Engineer
about: As a CSIE student at NDU, I build practical systems at the intersection of cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, and reliable software.
My work combines cyber defense research with a builder mindset: analyze vulnerabilities, secure the system, and deploy what actually works.

research.narrative: I am interested in building observable security systems that monitor network states, execute targeted defense playbooks, and provide clear threat evidence under human-in-the-loop oversight.

focus.name: Cybersecurity
focus.description: Monitoring network protocols, deploying EDR tools, configuring firewalls, and establishing active defense workflows.

focus.name: Applied AI
focus.description: Integrating machine learning classifiers (like Random Forest and Logistic Regression) into lightweight, practical detection systems.

focus.name: Web Development
focus.description: Designing interactive digital platforms, database connections, and full-stack utilities tailored for operational training.
